guestNotes.author: Elena Marsh
guestNotes.body: Celebrated a promotion on her last visit; sent a note from the GM.

guestNotes.author: Rosa Soto
guestNotes.body: Prefers text messages to calls for anything non-urgent.

guestNotes.author: Elena Marsh
guestNotes.body: Hosts client dinners at Linden; hold table 12 when he books.

guestNotes.author: Jonas Reyes
guestNotes.body: Invoices go to accounts@lakeshore.example.com, never the room folio.

guestNotes.author: Elena Marsh
guestNotes.body: Flies in on the overnight from Stockholm; room was ready at 09:15 today.

guestNotes.author: Rosa Soto
guestNotes.body: Speaking at the McCormick conference this week; may need the business centre printer.

guestNotes.author: Elena Marsh
guestNotes.body: Asked us to keep the same housekeeper (Aiyana) if possible.

guestNotes.author: Rosa Soto
guestNotes.body: Photographer; often carries equipment cases. Offer the luggage room.

guestNotes.author: Elena Marsh
guestNotes.body: Travelling with a colleague; separate folios requested.

guestNotes.author: Elena Marsh
guestNotes.body: First stay with us, travelling with a toddler. Welcome amenity for the little one is approved.

guestNotes.author: Rosa Soto
guestNotes.body: Dog is called Pepper. Add the pet cleaning fee to the folio.

guestNotes.author: Jonas Reyes
guestNotes.body: Mentioned a return trip in November for a trade show.

reservations.notes: Two twin beds, not a queen.
Tenth wedding anniversary; rose petals approved.
Early check-in granted, room was ready.
Feather-free pillows. Oat milk in the minibar.
Arriving on the last flight; guarantee on file.
Asked for a 13:00 check-in if the room is ready.
Quiet room away from the lift.
Rollaway bed for a third adult.
Champagne and a handwritten card on arrival; prefers a high floor.

handover.author: Jonas Reyes
handover.body: Revenue posted with no discrepancies. Two no-shows charged one night each.

handover.author: Elena Marsh
handover.body: eight Deluxe Kings held for 1 Oct. Rooming list is due by Friday noon.

handover.author: Gus Palmer
handover.body: air-conditioning swap finishes tomorrow at noon. Keep it off sale tonight.

handover.author: Rosa Soto
handover.body: Send self-parkers to the Grand Avenue garage; tickets are validated at the desk.
